_doc: Era functions (docs/ERA_FUNCTIONS.md). Each function the handheld monster-taming generations 1 to 5 brought, step by step, mapped to the Chimora era where it opens. era: the era that opens it (EraFeatures.is_unlocked); step: the generation step (1 to 5) that introduced it in the genre; kind: base (there from the start of Era I, kept so the story and old saves stay as they are), new (opens with that era) or upgrade (an older function gets a deeper version in that era). name and text are English; German in tools/i18n/de_era_functions.py. EraFeatures.new_in(era) lists the new and upgraded functions of an era for the era change and the Records page.

features.name: Bonding
features.text: Weaken a wild Spirling and bond with it.

features.name: Wardens and Rifts
features.text: Seal each Rift by beating its Warden.

features.name: Spirlog
features.text: Every kind you meet gets a page.

features.name: Trading
features.text: Swap Spirlings with friends.

features.name: Keepsakes
features.text: A Spirling can hold one item that works in battle.

features.name: Day and night
features.text: The clock changes the light and which Spirlings step out.

features.name: Time-bound unfurling
features.text: Some Spirlings only unfurl at a certain time of day.

features.name: Echo Cores
features.text: Two Spirlings sing a young one that inherits Spark and arts.

features.name: Gleam
features.text: A rare Spirling in different colours.

features.name: Focus
features.text: Focus arts and Focus defence are their own stat.

features.name: Two new elements
features.text: Rust and Mask Spirlings live in Vellmarch.

features.name: Warden rematches
features.text: Every Warden waits for a second, harder fight.

features.name: Pith Fruit
features.text: Held fruit that a Spirling eats by itself in a pinch.

features.name: Traits
features.text: Every kind has a passive trait.

features.name: Temperament
features.text: Each Spirling's temperament raises one stat and lowers another.

features.name: Double battles
features.text: Two Spirlings on each side at once.

features.name: Running
features.text: Hold the cancel button to run.

features.name: Fine training
features.text: Raise a Spirling's Spark one point at a time.

features.name: The Burrow
features.text: A hollow of your own to hang trophies in.

features.name: Two new elements
features.text: Acid and Frost Spirlings live in Quillmarch.

features.name: Weather in battle
features.text: Outdoors, rain, fog and storms now change battles: Tide, Umbra and Volt grow stronger.

features.name: Physical and Focus arts
features.text: Each art is physical, Focus or a status art.

features.name: Online duels and trades
features.text: Duel, trade and join a league over the internet.

features.name: Touch controls
features.text: Tap to walk and tap every menu.

features.name: Regional imprints
features.text: A kind that lives long in another region takes on its form.

features.name: Partner battles
features.text: Fight side by side with a companion.

features.name: Two new elements
features.text: Gilt and Zenith Spirlings live in Halcyra.

features.name: Battle stage
features.text: Battles stand on a wide stage with depth.

features.name: Echo Crystals
features.text: Teaching crystals that are never used up.

features.name: Seasons
features.text: Each season boosts its own elements.

features.name: Hidden gifts
features.text: Every line hides a second gift to wake.

features.name: Living battles
features.text: Spirlings move in battle and the camera follows.

features.name: Ring-scaled Growth
features.text: Beating a foe of a higher Ring gives more Growth, a lower one gives less.

features.name: Rustling spots
features.text: Once a day, a patch of grass shakes hard. A rare Spirling hides inside.

features.name: Triple battles
features.text: On every road a Wayfarer sends three Spirlings at once.
